content.bookings: Subscribe to a link in your calendar app (Google, Apple, Outlook, …) to see the lessons you and your family are booked for. Each lesson names who is booked; waiting lists are not included.
content.teaching: Subscribe to a link in your calendar app (Google, Apple, Outlook, …) to see the lessons you teach or accompany, with your part.
content.schedule: Subscribe to a link in your calendar app (Google, Apple, Outlook, …) to see the schedule of every location, as you see it here.
content.location: Subscribe to a link in your calendar app (Google, Apple, Outlook, …) to see the schedule of {{location}}, as you see it here.

window.bookings: It covers your bookings from four weeks back on. Lessons the school cancels stay in, marked as canceled.
window.other: It covers four weeks back and as far ahead as you may see the schedule. Lessons the school cancels stay in, marked as canceled.

refresh: Your calendar app fetches changes on its own, which can take a few hours.
secret: The link is secret: anyone who has it sees what it shows. Keep it to yourself; you can revoke it at any time.
loadFailed: Your calendar links could not be loaded.
none: You have no link for this calendar yet.
existing: You have a link for this calendar, created on {{created}}.
lastUsed: A calendar last fetched it on {{date}}.
neverUsed: No calendar has fetched it yet.
lostLink: Its address cannot be shown again. If you need it, create a new link.
regenerateWarning: The current link then stops working: calendars subscribed to it must subscribe to the new one.

created.title: Your new link
created.once: Copy it now: it is shown only this once. If you lose it, create a new one.
created.copyFailed: The link could not be copied. Select it and copy it yourself.
created.downloadFailed: The calendar could not be downloaded.
created.demo: The demo runs in your browser, so calendar apps cannot reach this link. Download the calendar as a file instead and import it into your calendar app.

revoke.question: Revoke this link?
revoke.explain: Calendars subscribed to it stop receiving updates. You can create a new link at any time.
revoke.notFound: This link had already been revoked or replaced.

errors.noStaff: There is no teaching of yours to subscribe to: your account is not linked to a staff record. Subscribe to the schedule instead.
errors.impersonating: While you are signed in as someone else, you cannot create calendar links: they would outlast the session.

visitor.title: Sign in to subscribe
visitor.text: Calendar links belong to an account, which keeps them secret and lets you revoke them. Sign in or create an account to see the schedule in your calendar app.

card.title: Calendar feeds
card.description: Links that show your lessons in your calendar app. Their addresses cannot be shown again: to subscribe somewhere else, create a new link from the schedule, My lessons or Teaching.
card.empty: You have no calendar links. Subscribe from the schedule, My lessons or Teaching.
